description: Java class for a dialog fragment that allows users to add a new restriction item by inputting a key and value, and communicates the addition via a listener interface.

classes.name: ItemAddFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that provides UI for adding a new restriction item with key and value inputs.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment and initializes the listener from parent fragment or context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and inflates the fragment's view, setting the dialog title.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes input fields and sets click listener for OK button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, dismissing the dialog if addItem() succeeds.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Validates input fields and notifies listener of new item addition.
